title: Present overdue state on a dedicated hierarchy-first visual surface

gates.name: Focused overdue display projection and regression suite

verify: Before any production behavior write, obtain honest task-scoped RED for the overdue presentation at the current baseline. Distinguish the dedicated no-weather/no-city/no-date/no-standard-card surface, elapsed-digit hierarchy, transparent circular preset-color backdrop, blinking plus and stable numeric counter. If any claim is already claim-equivalent GREEN, preserve that pre-implementation result and do not force a production change.

Implement only the overdue composition refinement inside DisplayCapability.kt and its deterministic DisplayProjectionTest.kt proof. Main Display consumes the existing Timer & Alert projection; it does not calculate elapsed time, write timer state, dispatch audio, alter any-tap dismissal or introduce a second lifecycle owner.

Obtain claim-equivalent host GREEN at one fixed render size using idle, W27 active-countdown and overdue comparisons. Record hidden weather/card/city/date content, full elapsed value, idle/active/overdue text sizes, backdrop shape/fill/color identity, blinking-plus state, numeric stability and clipping/overlap results. Elapsed digits must exceed idle and exceed active countdown where the existing geometry permits without clipping or overlap; do not invent a fixed dp or product ratio.

Apply a named Reviewer/visual-QA rubric to the same host render for focal hierarchy, dedicated-surface content exclusion, activating-preset color identity, transparent circular treatment, blinking plus, stable numeric result, readability, no clipping/overlap and host/device evidence separation. The rubric is evidence, not a T3 checkpoint.

Run read-only regressions for existing any-tap overdue dismissal and Timer & Alert lifecycle/audio contracts. Prove through focused/full host results and boundary inspection that TimerCapability.kt, TimerAlertPolicy.kt and PlatformRuntimeAdapter.kt remain unchanged and that W23 audio request/start/repeat/stop ownership is not reopened or claimed by W28.

Record target, physical-device and audio runtime evidence as DEFERRED with the unavailable-target condition and residual readability/custom-ROM/audio risk. Host geometry or fake audio must never be promoted to physical audibility or runtime PASS; no emulator, device, adb, network, credentials or audio runtime is part of this planning handoff.

Run the required build, focused/full host and Memory Bank/diff gates with disposable synthetic timer state, safe rerun/reset and cleanup. Preserve all historical task cards, evidence, protocols, scheduler checkpoint, lifecycle/REQ state and terminal state.

Stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-007 if satisfying the active-countdown comparison requires a new fixed visual ratio, dp target or gradient stop. Stop and route to /spec-design or /feature-to-tasks FT-007 if the outcome needs a new module, graph edge, public contract, dependency, permission, event boundary, lifecycle/audio change or any write outside the exact two-file boundary.

purpose: Apply the operator-authorized overdue presentation refinement on the Main Display boundary: a dedicated no-weather/no-city/no-date/no-standard-card surface with a stable full elapsed counter, materially stronger hierarchy than idle and active countdown where existing geometry permits, and a transparent neon circular backdrop using the activating preset color, while keeping Timer & Alert lifecycle, any-tap dismissal and audio behavior read-only.
success_outcome: Fresh claim-linked host RED/GREEN and named visual-QA evidence prove that overdue renders on the dedicated content-free surface, full elapsed digits stay stable and materially larger than idle and the active countdown where permitted, the transparent circular backdrop preserves activating-preset color identity, and the blinking plus remains legible; existing any-tap, lifecycle and audio contracts remain unchanged, while target/device/audio are explicitly DEFERRED with no physical-audibility or runtime PASS claim.
anti_goals: Do not change TimerCapability.kt, TimerAlertPolicy.kt, PlatformRuntimeAdapter.kt, FoundationRuntime, MainActivity, Settings, resources or any other production/test path outside the exact two-file write boundary.
Do not repair, redesign or claim W23 audio emission/start/repeat/stop, built-in signal selection, volume, ramp, cap, silent/DND/route policy or physical audibility.

Do not change Timer & Alert elapsed arithmetic, idle/countdown/overdue transitions, one-active-timer behavior, temporary recovery, any-tap overdue dismissal or the existing public capability contract.
Do not add a lifecycle state, private-store access, event/message boundary, dependency, permission, resource pipeline, network path, composition-root orchestration or new audio framework.
Do not select a fixed dp, font ratio, surface ratio or gradient stop when the existing adaptive geometry cannot satisfy the visual comparison; stop and route the material product decision instead.

Do not run or claim emulator/device/adb/network/credential/audio runtime evidence, and do not modify historical task status, evidence, protocols, scheduler checkpoint, lifecycle/REQ state or terminal history.

The smallest correction requires any Timer & Alert, Android Runtime Adapter, Settings, lifecycle, audio, permission, resource, public-contract, module, dependency or composition-root change; stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-007 or /spec-design as applicable.

Target/device/audio runtime is unavailable; continue only with mandatory host proof, record target/device/audio as DEFERRED and never substitute host/fake evidence for runtime PASS or physical audibility.

Any production or test behavior write falls outside DisplayCapability.kt or DisplayProjectionTest.kt, or any workflow action would change historical status/evidence, checkpoint, lifecycle/REQ state or terminal history.

constraints: Main Display owns user-facing overdue composition and may refine it only within DisplayCapability.kt; it consumes Timer & Alert projection data and does not calculate elapsed time or write timer state.

The overdue surface must contain no weather cards, city, date or standard card-shell content; full elapsed digits remain stable, materially exceed idle and exceed active countdown where the existing geometry permits without clipping/overlap.
The transparent neon circular backdrop reuses the activating preset's existing PresetPresentation color identity; the large plus blinks while the numeric result remains stable.
Existing any-tap overdue dismissal, Timer & Alert lifecycle/rehydration and audio policy remain unchanged read-only contracts owned by their existing capabilities and W23 history.
Host visual proof is claim-linked and isolated; target readability/fullscreen, physical audio and custom-ROM behavior are explicitly DEFERRED and never inferred from host or fake evidence.
No new fixed visual ratio, dp target, gradient stop, lifecycle state, public boundary, dependency, permission, event path, storage owner, network path or composition-root orchestration is authorized.
